🚀 Senior Mechanical Engineer – Battery Pack (Series A, hybrid in Oakland)

Hey 👋 we're Voltaic, a 25-person team building battery packs for electric boats.

🔧 What you'll do
• Own the mechanical design of our 800V pack from concept to production
• Run thermal simulation and CFD for cooling plates
• Work with our firmware folks on BMS and CAN bus integration

✅ What you bring
• 5+ years designing EV powertrain or battery hardware
• Strong SolidWorks skills and GD&T
• Hands-on prototyping (3D printing, sheet metal)

✨ Bonus points
• ANSYS Fluent
• Experience with composites or injection molding

🎁 Perks
• Equity, 401k, unlimited PTO
• Annual budget for Python or MATLAB courses

Voltaic is an equal opportunity employer.
